findings.summary: The `??` fallback's hoisted preparation was one site of a general defect: the general `?:` path, numeric `||`, the `(c && x) || null` sink, `Number(a ?? b)` and a conditional's object identity also emitted an arm's preparation ahead of the select. `DataLowerer.compileArm` and `armExpression` now carry every short-circuit arm (Doom's `giveAmmo`, Racer's placement clone).

`fallbackForSink`, the found-flag fallback and the pair selection in `compileNullishCoalesce` share `compileArm`/`armExpression` instead of three hand-written capture-and-lambda copies; the pair path is one `pinNullishPair` selection with no mutable state, and a prepared null fallback refuses instead of dropping its lines.
`compileConditionalForSink` compiles its branches through `compileArm`, so every caller enters runtime control flow the same way.
A prepared arm that awaits refuses in `armExpression`: `co_await` cannot sit in the lambda.
The struct sink's own `?:` arm is unreachable (`compileForSink` routes every non-boolean conditional to the conditional sink first) and is deleted.
`float_to_half` and `float_to_half_toward_zero` duplicated their bit split; the store's rounding is the one conversion and `half_to_float` is the shared decode (screenshots and the half-store test).
The SDL cube upload builds each face with `upload_2d_texture`, the cube drops its colour-target usage, and `generate_texture_mipmaps` loses its unused layer loop.

The SDL grab samples through `ground_sampler` (the bilinear sampler) instead of a dedicated sampler; its stage pairs and fullscreen pipelines come from two local helpers shared with image processing; three comments describing the removed resolve-and-blit are rewritten.

A transmission frame no longer resolves the multisampled attachment: the grab and the per-sample image processing both load the samples, so the resolve into `state.color` was a full-resolution copy nothing read.
`pixels_texture_data` replaces four hand-copied PixelsTexture-to-TextureData blocks in the material factories.

`textureFile.srgb` has no reader after the linear-slot refusals went and is removed; the renderer manifest's per-slot encodings (and its rgba32f BRDF LUT) were stale and now state that material textures sample through their own format.
`goldenFixedFrame` reads the retained-UI flag itself; its callers and the parity binding that restated it go.
The gate tightening loosened scene 24's 0.0002 Dawn gate; both backends keep 0.0002.
Test cleanups: the texture-identity test reads `base_color_texture.srgb` instead of pasting `material_slot_srgb` behind a stub enum; stale header and test names follow the behaviour.

Pass `data.has_image() ? data.srgb : fallback` inside the upload functions instead of a separate srgb argument, and build the base-colour factor texel as its own TextureData so `material_slot_srgb` reduces to the field.
findings.blockedBy: Declined for this change: it reshapes both backends' upload signatures and the fallback-texel bake, beyond the encoding fix it would tidy.

findings.summary: SDL compute cube mipmaps (pal_sdl_gpu_compute_mipmaps.hpp) blit each face in place and may filter across faces as the reflection cube did.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: no registered scene measures a residual on that path; the cube fix here was driven by scene 24's measured SDL-only difference.

findings.summary: Draw the SDL grab's mip chain with the pinned mip-blit module, as Dawn does, instead of SDL_GenerateMipmapsForGPUTexture.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: every transmission scene measures 0.000 on both backends with the current chain.

findings.summary: Emit the RGBD store's rounding from the lowered pinned kernel, or execute the kernel at generation, instead of the hand-written toward-zero conversion.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the conversion is the reference device's storage-write rounding, documented in fidelity.md and pinned by the half-store test.

findings.summary: bblite-tint writes HLSL 2021 and compiles shader model 6.0 while Dawn defaults to HLSL 2018 and the device's highest model.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: unmeasured; -Gis alone made the backends agree on Freeciv, and HLSL/SM changes need their own measured sweep.

findings.summary: Declare retained-UI scenes' fixed frame in the registry instead of deriving it from the compiled manifest.
findings.blockedBy: Declined for this change: it moves an existing rule's home across every retained-UI registry entry; this change only extended the rule to canvas-only captures.

findings.summary: Use DONT_CARE for the grab target's load op, route DXC through runConcurrently, and have a generation-resolved find return a literal found flag.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the pin clears the grab target; the serial DXC loop and the find's named flag predate this change and cost nothing at run time.
